method: Matching native frames and saved berth, lens on/off. World RGB difference, identical title HUD pixels, deep-shadow and yellow-highlight coverage. Full images inspected visually.
aperture: 48-tap, eight-blade iris, edge cat-eye compression, isolated highlight footprint compensation
focus: Central five-depth cross; opaque-depth silhouette rejection; five-pixel geometric blur cap
pipeline: Opaque HDR + atmosphere + SSR + glass-space refraction -> optical HDR -> highlight seed -> aperture bokeh -> single display transform + halation/flare -> physical cockpit -> HUD
limits: Screen-space camera approximation; transparent surfaces use opaque depth; no temporal autofocus history; no simulated lens geometry.
